title: Skip the Bad Input
statementMd:
A file of "numbers" also contains junk. Add up the real numbers and count the rest.

`Integer.parseInt("abc")` throws a **NumberFormatException** — catch it, count that token as skipped, and carry on with the next one.

**Input**
Line 1: `n`. Line 2: n whitespace-separated tokens.

**Output**
Line 1: `Sum: <total of the valid numbers>`. Line 2: `Skipped: <count>`.
hints: Integer.parseInt(token) throws NumberFormatException when the text isn’t a number.
Put the parse and the addition inside try; put skipped++ inside catch, so the loop simply continues.
